lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters (spots) arranged in a regular geometric lattice across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows at near-perpendicular angles, forming a distinct grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition with light-reflecting dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a scattered distribution of approximately 10-15 smaller, lower-intensity circular blobs confined within its silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, elongated silhouette consistent with a commensal organism (remora) is attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
